warnings: Axes: x = numbered grids 1-6 (4.00/3.50/3.00/3.00/3.00 = 16.50); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom ซ, ช, ฉ, จ, ง, ค, ข, ก (1.00/1.00/1.00/2.00/1.00/3.00/1.50 = 10.50). Origin = top-left ซ1 (same convention as houses 53/65/66).
Two dummy x lines carry interior beams: 4' (B6) and 5' (B8). [5' is now 5'' (15.00) after the S-05 sweep.]
Only S-01/S-02 (floor-1 combined plans) were swept for this grid master; upper floor, roof and architectural sheets were not (op04 time budget).

S-03 floor-2 plan (หน้า16) swept 2026-10-23 via tools/gridfix.py: new x dummies 2' 5.80 (2+1.80), 3' 9.00 (2+1.80+1.70+1.50, = 3+1.50), 5'' 15.50 (5+2.00); 4' 11.50 re-confirmed (5-2.00). New y dummies จ' 3.50 (จ+0.50), จ'' 4.50 (ง-0.50), ค' 7.45 (ค+1.45) — renamed ค'' when S-04 (หน้า17) added 7.10. No existing line was renamed, so no earlier ref moved. [Renamed 2026-10-23 by S-05's ticks: 2' -> 2'', 5'' -> 5''' — the names above are the names at the time of the S-03 sweep.]

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- ค' -> ค''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names

S-04 roof-beam plan (หน้า17) swept 2026-10-23: main x/y rows identical to S-01..S-03; new y tick ค+1.10 = 7.10 (locates roof beam B23 in bay 1-2) became ค', so the S-03 line at 7.45 was re-sequenced to ค'' by tools/gridfix.py (refs in หน้า16 renamed with it, positions unchanged).

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 2' -> 2'', 5' -> 5'', 5'' -> 5'''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names

S-05 roof-frame plan (หน้า18) swept 2026-10-23: x eave/hip ticks -1.20 (1.20 before 1) = 1', 1.50 and 2.50 (two 2.70 rows off the left-roof eaves) = 1''/1''', 5.20 (2+1.20, and ~2.30 to 3) = 2', 14.50 (3.20 back from the 6+1.20 eave) = 5', 17.70 (6+1.20) = 6'. gridfix re-sequenced the existing dummies: old 2' 5.80 -> 2'', old 5' 15.00 -> 5'', old 5'' 15.50 -> 5''' (refs in หน้า15/หน้า16 renamed, positions unchanged; prose in those files updated by hand). The two 3.20 rows over the right roof touch no known line and stay 'edge' chains; the vertical 2.70/3.20/1.20 roof dimensions are in unassigned_dimensions (row anchors not resolved at this scan).
